weekly: Introduction to research methods in education: The origin of research Additional Information: Overview of the course and expectations from the students will be explained. The nature of inquiry will specifically focused on.

Historical research, Surveys, Additional Information: Students will find articles done on historical and survey research. They will brief about the articles found to others in the class. Discussion of the methods and their practical use will be done.

Experimental research, Action research Additional Information: Students will find articles done on Experimental and Action research. They will brief about the articles found to others in the class. Discussion of the methods and their practical use will be done.

Mixed method research Ex post facto research Additional Information: Students will find articles done on Mixed method research and Ex post facto research. A discussion will take place to evaluate theory and practice in using the methods. Also, they will brief about the articles found to others in the class.

Case study Ethnographic research Additional Information: Students will find articles done on case study and ethnographic research. They will brief about the articles found to others in the class. Discussion of the methods and their practical use will be done.
Defining a research problem Identifying variables Constructing hypothesis

Data collection tools: questionnaire, interview & observations Triangulation in research Additional Information: Students will find an instrument from the literature and brief the others in the class on what was the procedure it was developed.
Selecting a sample to collect data

Validity, reliability and ethics in educational research-1 Additional Information: Finding examples from articles or thesis how they go about reliability, validity and ethics. A discussion and commenting period will follow
Validity, reliability and ethics in educational research-2
Data analysis in educational research Writing a project report Additional Information: Quantitative and qualitative data and how to handle it in analysis
Presenting literature reviews (Students) Evaluation of the course
